free_tier.stated: 5 GB of file storage per team on Free; unlimited on Twist Unlimited. 100 MB per attachment.

tooling: Twist REST API (api.twist.com/api/v3) with attachment upload by `file_id`; OAuth2 app registration. Weaker client ecosystem than Slack.
chaining: Unlimited free teams per account ('create a separate, free team'), so N teams x 5 GB is trivially repeatable. But each team needs its own members/invites.
limits_note: 5 GB/team; 100 MB/attachment; 10 MB for emailed attachments; free-plan thread history older than one month is not viewable (though Twist explicitly retains it server-side and never deletes).
reliability_note: No deletion stated ('nothing will ever be deleted'), which is unusual and good. The 5 GB cap is the wall.

evidence.proved: 'There is a 100MB file size limit for attachments'; 'When using the Free plan of Twist, the storage limit is 5GB.'
'all your team's data will still be safely stored on our servers – nothing will ever be deleted'
the Free plan of Twist still has a 5GB file storage limit
evidence.quote: When using the Free plan of Twist, the storage limit is 5GB. If your team is using the [Twist Unlimited](https://twistapp.com/pricing) plan, you’ll have unlimited file storage.

evidence.proved: attachments are capped at 100MB and forwarded-email attachments at 10MB
evidence.quote: Yes. There is a 100MB file size limit for attachments and a 10MB file size attachment limit when [forwarding emails to Twist](https://twist.com/help/articles/forward-emails-to-twist-pPt1bBUs).

evidence.proved: the first-party pricing page announces Twist shuts down on March 1, 2027
evidence.quote: Todoist Comms is replacing Twist. Workspace admins can choose when to move their team before Twist shuts down on March 1, 2027. [Learn how to move your team](https://twist.com/help/articles/move-your-team-from-twist-to-todoist-comms-cAhB9a6GO "Move your team from Twist to Todoist Comms").
